correctness.rationale: Hyperbolic interpolation gives an exact pair-block factorization for all ℓ2 input. The integer-grid convolution symbol and common zero-cell Bloch eigenvectors establish sharp exterior extrema. At every cell frequency, the trace/determinant identities yield two exact strictly negative characteristic-polynomial evaluations away from the opposite cell corner; their factor brackets are positive for 0<r<1, 0≤X≤1, 0<m≤p. The two eigenvalue ranges therefore form exactly the stated bands with an internal gap if δ>0. Expansion of sinh gives the quadratic collision constant. A standalone packaged script verified both critical symbolic identities exactly and scanned all band endpoints for 20 parameter combinations; finite testing is supplemental.

value.rationale: This natural, critically dense, alternating perturbation of cardinal Laplace interpolation is the simplest nonuniform periodic sampling geometry. A complete and sharp classification of the two spectral bands (including interior gap onset, all four edges and collision asymptotic) captures substantial conditioning structure absent from the qualitative sampling theorem. This continuum result is not a routine finite-grid recomputation; its gap proof requires a nontrivial global characteristic-polynomial sign factorization.
